sections.markdown:
## D — Sharing the road with vulnerable users and large vehicles
Accuracy boundary: Sharing the road with vulnerable users and large vehicles uses only the selected physical Idaho handbook pages, with one claim and one page per fact block.
Passing clearance keeps minimum and higher-speed qualifications. Motorcycle following time is strictly more than the stated interval. Example truck stopping distance remains an attributed scenario with all printed conditions. Cross-page instructions, unread visuals and unqualified legal universals remain typed debt.
Commercial licensing, motorcycle permits and unrelated paragraphs on mixed pages are outside the assigned passenger-car scope. No diagram has been converted into an invented verbal rule.

corpus_stability.reason: Corpus is the frozen July handbook snapshot; future issuer changes require a new source registration, rather than silent updates to this corpus.

verification_debt.claim_text: Actual emergency activity, local sidewalk rules, bicycle access restrictions and hazardous-material crossing exceptions require the appropriate current official context. No actual traffic opening or permit dimension is invented.
